main_body: A grey iron mine cart: a rim band at the top, a dark body below it, two wheels at the bottom, and a few gold ore nuggets on top.
top_band: At x=8 there is a light grey rim at row 4 (L=170) and a mid grey row 5 (L=126). That is about 2 rows, followed by dark body tones (L=82 and 61) from row 6 down. No wide light horizontal surface is visible.
evidence: The cart reads as a front elevation with a thin rim. The 1-2 row light rim (rows 4-5) is the only top-like element, so this is the 'rim only' failure from the guide. Below it the body is dark and flat (rows 6-11), and no elliptical opening or interior surface can be seen. The gold nuggets sit above the rim rather than showing a visible interior. A container needs its opening seen from above, so this fails.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 9 distinct colours, against 38-40 in the references, and a median of 9 colours per tile, against 17-20. 92% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outline is a near-black grey sticker line instead of a tinted dark material tone as in the references (1% and 33% neutral). The grey ramp has about 5 steps, but the body is mostly large dark bands (L=61 and 82) with little grain or per-part texture. The piece is clearly thinner and flatter than the Beodeul references.
